name: Strata
title: Strata: free ChatGPT Plus alternative
hook: ChatGPT Plus charges you twenty bucks a month to chat with an AI. This app does it for free.
job: Runs a private AI on your PC

features.intro: It's a chat that lives on your PC.
features.say: Ask questions, write code, even show it pictures.
It runs on your own graphics card, so your chats stay private.
Watch its speed and your graphics card live.

caption:
ChatGPT Plus charges $20/month. Strata gives you a private AI chat on your own PC for free 🤖

✅ Chat, write code and show it pictures
✅ Runs on your own graphics card, chats stay on your PC
✅ Live monitor of speed and GPU
✅ No account, no cloud, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ It's a beta and needs a decent PC: at least 32 GB of RAM + graphics memory together, about 80 GB free disk, and a 40-70 GB model download on first start. Not for old laptops.

Comment "CHAT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
